changes: Conversation duration accurately reflects speech length instead of the full audio streaming session
Ask Omi and other buttons use the same icons as the tab bar again

Locked memories stay hidden when you long-press them
The NotePin S now appears when you scan for devices, instead of only after it had been connected once
Speaker recognition keeps working after a transcription hiccup, and voice clips play from the right moment in long recordings.

Conversations count the people who actually spoke instead of every speaker label, so a long pendant recording no longer shows hundreds of others
New Home Screen widgets: your devices' battery, your next tasks, and your latest conversation
The live recording card on Home is easier to read: an icon shows what is recording, problems say what happened and what to expect, and Pause or Resume always matches what is actually happening
Speaker names now appear immediately when you label a transcript, with a retry if saving fails
Recordings waiting their turn to upload no longer show up as failed.

Long conversation titles and related generated labels are now easier to read on mobile.

Pendant questions now keep listening after you release the button and tell you when speech was not detected.

A pendant recording and its phone backup now stay one conversation.
Speaker names stay editable when synced conversations merge, and uncertain speaker labels no longer appear as extra people
Voice questions now move past clips that are no longer available.
Omi now recognizes an already-connected pendant when iOS restores its Bluetooth link after the app restarts.
Capture recovery alerts now appear only when Omi needs your action, so quiet recordings no longer show a false audio warning.

Conversation titles and compact description fields now align cleanly when they fit on one line.

Improved iPhone reliability when device diagnostics contain invalid values.

Conversation summaries refresh after you label a speaker, so they can use the person's name

Fixed a person page showing no conversations even for people you had labeled
People show how many conversations they are in, with search, filters, select and bulk delete, and a person page that lists their conversations
